title: SceneClaw: driving video to a 4D code world
subtitle: Waymo Open Dataset, San Francisco, day · 199 frames at 10 fps · one agent session (v23.6)
task: Reconstruct this driving clip as an editable 4D blocks world.

steps.label: Plan
steps.text:
Build the clip in four phases, each closed by a check bar: (A) camera, ground and road; (B) buildings and street furniture; (C) vehicles, people and trees; (D) one whole-scene look, then export `scene_world.py`. Tools only propose; every proposal is checked on overlays of the photo and on the BEV before it is kept.
First look: an 8-frame grid, ego speed and yaw, camera jolts, and a metric-scale check.
kv: height 2.27 m, pitch down 0.94 deg, rmse 0.018

# ... b001 -> wall w011; the last placement ran along the road

c4.prisms[iw].update(poly=[...0.6 m thick...], z0=z0, z1=z0+3.4)
